ModMetaData.name: RimTalk 人设特质包 RimTalk Persona Traits
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
一个轻量级的角色扮演向特质包：10 个「对话人设」特质（性格/说话风格/嗜好），无数值改动、纯描述、纯 XML。 每个特质的描述都专为 RimTalk 的提示词注入优化：使用 {PAWN_nameDef} 等占位符、写明说话方式与话题，让 AI 对话更有「人味」。
A lightweight roleplay-oriented trait pack: 10 "conversational persona" traits (personality / speech style / hobbies), no stat changes, description-only, pure XML. Every trait description is optimized for RimTalk's prompt injection: it uses {PAWN_nameDef} placeholders and spells out how the pawn speaks and what it talks about, so AI dialogue feels more alive.
